mapper.select: SELECT id,source_item_id,target_item_id,source_version_id,target_version_id,target_revision_after,created_at FROM knowledge_concept_merge WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_item_id=#{sourceId}
SELECT item_id,x,y FROM knowledge_position WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{id}

SELECT CONCAT(CASE WHEN b.item_id=#{ids[0]} THEN 'SOURCE_' ELSE 'TARGET_' END,b.kind) AS kind, CONCAT(b.item_id,'/',b.binding_id) AS id,b.version_id,b.revision FROM ( SELECT r.item_id,'BOARD_VERSIONS' AS kind,CONCAT(r.board_id,'/',r.board_revision) AS binding_id, r.version_id,r.board_revision AS revision FROM knowledge_board_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'MEMORY_SOURCES',CONCAT(r.card_id,'/',r.version_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM memory_card_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.concept_id,'MEMORY_CONCEPTS',CONCAT(r.card_id,'/',r.version_id),r.version_id,0 FROM memory_card_concept r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.concept_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'QUESTION_VERSIONS',CONCAT(r.question_id,'/',r.version_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM question_knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_source_item_id,'PREPARATION_VERSIONS',CAST(r.id AS CHAR),r.knowledge_source_version_id,0 FROM preparation_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND r.knowledge_source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.target_item_id,'BACKLINKS',r.id,r.source_version_id,0 FROM knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.target_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'OUTGOING_REFERENCES',r.id,r.source_version_id,0 FROM knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'TRAINING_QUESTIONS',CONCAT(r.question_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM training_question_knowledge_snapshot r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'TRAINING_DRAFTS',CONCAT(r.question_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM training_draft_knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'TRAINING_ANSWERS',CONCAT(r.answer_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM training_answer_knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'MEMORY_ATTEMPTS',CONCAT(r.attempt_id,'/',r.knowledge_version_id), r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM memory_attempt_knowledge_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_source_item_id,'INTERVIEW_MATERIALS',CONCAT(r.event_id,'/',r.event_revision,'/',r.ordinal), r.knowledge_source_version_id,r.event_revision FROM interview_event_material r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND r.knowledge_source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'AI_DRAFT_INPUTS',CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal),r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM ai_draft_knowledge_input r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'RELATION_SUPPLEMENT_SOURCES',CONCAT(r.supplement_id,'/',r.ordinal),r.source_version_id,0 FROM knowledge_relation_supplement_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'AI_KNOWLEDGE_ADOPTIONS', CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal,'/',d.target_item_id,'/',d.target_version_id),r.source_version_id,0 FROM ai_knowledge_source r JOIN ai_candidate_decision d ON d.owner_id=r.owner_id AND d.task_id=r.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED' WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'AI_QUESTION_ADOPTIONS', CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal,'/',d.target_question_id,'/',d.target_version_id),r.source_version_id,0 FROM ai_question_source r JOIN ai_question_decision d ON d.owner_id=r.owner_id AND d.task_id=r.task_id AND d.status='ADOPTED' WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'AI_RELATION_INPUTS',CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal),r.source_version_id,0 FROM ai_relation_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_item_id,'AI_CARD_INPUTS',CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal),r.source_version_id,0 FROM ai_card_draft_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'AI_SOURCE_QA_INPUTS',CONCAT(r.task_id,'/',r.ordinal),r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM ai_source_qa_source r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.domain='KNOWLEDGE' AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id,'STANDARD_REVIEW_EVIDENCE', CONCAT(r.review_id,'/',r.revision,'/',r.evidence_id),r.knowledge_version_id,r.revision FROM standard_review_evidence r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.basis_kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.source_id,'TODAY_PLACEMENTS',r.id,NULL,r.revision FROM today_placement r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND r.source_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT p.source_id,'TODAY_PLACEMENT_HISTORY',CONCAT(r.placement_id,'/',r.revision),NULL,r.revision FROM today_placement_history r JOIN today_placement p ON p.owner_id=r.owner_id AND p.id=r.placement_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND p.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND p.source_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT r.knowledge_item_id, CASE r.role WHEN 'REVIEW_DEPENDENCY' THEN 'MEMORY_REVIEW_DEPENDENCIES' WHEN 'REVIEW_OBSERVED_CURRENT' THEN 'MEMORY_REVIEW_OBSERVATIONS' WHEN 'IMPACT_DEPENDENCY' THEN 'MEMORY_IMPACT_DEPENDENCIES' WHEN 'IMPACT_PREVIOUS' THEN 'MEMORY_IMPACT_PREVIOUS' WHEN 'IMPACT_CURRENT' THEN 'MEMORY_IMPACT_CURRENT' END, CONCAT(r.history_id,'/',r.role,'/',r.source_ordinal),r.knowledge_version_id,0 FROM memory_source_history_knowledge_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.knowledge_item_id IN #{id} ) b ORDER BY kind,id,version_id,revision LIMIT #{limit}
